Adding More Storeys

A man drives home from the office, and the drive fills up with everything that got him there. The chess games as a boy, the all-nighters, the holidays, the watch. The house waiting at the end of it is the argument. A life built to a standard deserves an address that matches.

Brand film for The Storeys Golf Coast, a residential development in Ahmedabad. Fully AI-generated, original voiceover, no crew and no shoot.
